name: Volumetric Dense Image-to-Model Tracking
definition: A pose optimization algorithm that tracks camera motion by aligning the camera image to the volumetric dense map using radiance field rendering equations.
summary: Volumetric Dense Image-to-Model Tracking optimizes camera poses by aligning query images to pre-existing volumetric maps, offering smoother, more accurate trajectories than sparse tracking by utilizing all available image and model information.
